Chapter 6703: High Heaven’S Descent?

Chapter 6703: High Heaven’s Descent?

They reflected the high heaven instead - the end of the world with countless tribulations and primordial lights.

This was still not the source since both were merely images. Deeper was a flame never seen before. It surpassed anything seen in a fiery tribulation and looked like a lotus.

This flame gave birth to the tribulations and primordial lights—the prerequisites for creating a high heaven.

Regardless of the high heaven’s manifestation and form, it was still alive. This fiery lotus was life.

“Pop!” The two figures entered the primordial battlefield, pacing with the high heaven’s rhythm.

Everyone felt the urge to kneel, not daring to lift their head.

“The high heaven?!” Spectators were shocked.

This power was unprecedented. Even the strongest tribulation didn’t give this presence, not the Tribulation Vessel Avatar either.

“They can’t be. Who are they then?” A supreme overlord said. These two were strangely familiar, seemingly alive yet not.

Supreme overlords didn’t understand these beings. They appeared to be immortals but not quite compared to the known ones.

Was this an immortal never seen before, hence the confusion? Have they been hiding in Three Immortals all this time?

“Seniors, you two actually succeeded.” Taichu was surprised to see them.

“It was far from easy, had to find it on top of surviving the villainous heaven, and then had to abandon the self and then endure it.” One of the two laughed and said.

“He’s Evil Transformation!” Supreme Black Ancestor shouted.

“Your disciple contributed the most.” The other said.

“I merely tried my best.” Weizhen bowed.

“He’s... Fiendish Ground.” Another powerful cultivator followed Black’s lead and recognized the voice.

Everyone was shocked, especially Bao Pu and Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

“How can this be?!” Bao Pu became alarmed.

They killed and devoured these two, how did they come back even stronger? However, given Weizhen’s expression, this had to be true.

“They didn’t die entirely.” The ghost recalled a flashing primordial light when their astral body crumbled. He thought little of it, being occupied with devouring as much flesh and blood as possible.

Before this, Weizhen used his master’s bodies to help the duo take down these primordial immortals, removing their indestructible shells with the help of the tribulation source. This somehow ended better for the primordial immortals.

“Quite a slick move in this game, abandoning your body and wearing someone else’s.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We owe it to you. It’s not easy for us to die traditionally yet extremely easy for the high heaven to kill us. We needed to shed the shell with utmost caution.” Evil Transformation said.

“This shored body is wonderful.” Fiendish Ground had the aura of the high heaven instead of his original ghastly one.

“So that’s what happened.” An overlord understood.

“Weizhen, you tricked us!” Bao Pu shouted.

“Brother, that’s unfair since I merely carried out my end of the bargain. You obtained your wish and the seniors were able to shed, a perfect outcome.” Weizhen said.

Bao Pu and the ghost couldn’t retort because his logic was sound. The agreement was carried out entirely.

Alas, it turned out the two primordial immortals wanted to shed their shells. They couldn’t do it themselves due to the risk of a fatal tribulation. Moreover, they wanted new bodies through the shoring process.

Therefore, they let the tribulation source destroy their body enough for Bao Pu and the ghost to shoulder their flesh and blood.
